answer_1.quote: We investigate how qualitative advantages of LLMs change when fine-tuning on parallel data. We consider LLaMA and Falcon models, with parameter counts ranging from 7 billion up to 65 billion. The LLM properties we investigate are general translation quality, formality steerability, non-literalness in idiom translations, performance on specialized domains, and performance on document-level input which requires contextualisation of ambiguous tokens.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates machine translation outputs in terms of translation quality, formality control, idiom handling, domain-specific translation, and document-level contextualization.

answer_2.quote: Following the recommendation of , we report COMET scores . We do not report BLEU scores , since this metric is known to have a poor correlation with human judgments .
